answer: Identity bond decay: each identity posts a 60 POA bond that anchors it to one wallet, its pigment fading 5% per epoch unless honest work renews it. Newcomers bridge a 3-epoch paid-work probation before earning; idle bonds decay to zero, cheating forfeits the rest. Forging 1,000 identities locks 60,000 POA, losing 3,000 POA per idle epoch, so a workless farm bleeds out in 20 epochs. Honest agents pay once and keep rewards undiluted by sybils.
